fullPassage: Education must focus on the trunk of the tree of knowledge, revealing the ways in which the branches, twigs, and leaves all emerge from a common core. Tools for thinking stem from this core, providing a common language with which practitioners in different fields may share their experience of the process of innovation and discover links between their creative activities. When the same terms are employed across the curriculum, students begin to link different subjects and classes. If they practice abstracting in writing class, if they work on abstracting in painting or drawing class, and if, in all cases, they call it abstracting, they begin to understand how to think beyond disciplinary boundaries. They see how to transform their thoughts from one mode of conception and expression to another. Linking the disciplines comes naturally when the terms and tools are presented as part of a universal imagination.

questions.passage: Linking the disciplines comes __________ (natural) when the terms and tools are presented as part of a universal imagination.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: 학문 연결이 '자연스럽게' 이루어진다 → 동사 comes를 수식하는 부사 naturally
det.analysis: Linking the disciplines comes __________ → 동사(comes)를 수식하는 부사 자리. natural(형용사) → naturally(부사).

questions.passage: Education must focus on the trunk of the tree of knowledge, revealing the ways in which the branches, twigs, and leaves all emerge from __________. Tools for thinking stem from this core, providing a common language with which practitioners in different fields may share their experience of the process of innovation and discover links between their creative activities. When the same terms are employed across the curriculum, students begin to link different subjects and classes. If they practice abstracting in writing class, if they work on abstracting in painting or drawing class, and if, in all cases, they call it abstracting, they begin to understand how to think beyond disciplinary boundaries. They see how to transform their thoughts from one mode of conception and expression to another. Linking the disciplines comes naturally when the terms and tools are presented as part of a universal imagination.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 가지, 잔가지, 잎이 '공통 핵심'에서 나오므로, 교육은 지식의 나무 줄기에 초점을 맞춰야 한다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① a common core — 공통 핵심. 가지/잔가지/잎이 여기서 나온다는 비유 ←정답
❌ ② a common language — 공통 언어 (본문에 있으나 emerge from과 결합 시 나무 비유에 부적합)
❌ ③ the same terms — 같은 용어 (본문에 있으나 emerge from과 결합 시 부자연)
❌ ④ different fields — 다른 분야 (본문에 있으나 emerge from different fields는 문맥 반대)
det.tip: a common core = 공통 핵심. 나무 비유에서 줄기=핵심, 가지=분야

questions.passage: Education must focus on the trunk of the tree of knowledge, revealing the ways in which the branches, twigs, and leaves all emerge from a common core. Tools for thinking stem from this core, providing a common language with which practitioners in different fields may share their experience of the process of innovation and discover links between their creative activities. When the same terms are employed across the curriculum, students begin to link different subjects and classes. If they practice abstracting in writing class, if they work on abstracting in painting or drawing class, and if, in all cases, they call it abstracting, they begin to understand how to think beyond __________. They see how to transform their thoughts from one mode of conception and expression to another. questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 추상화를 연습하면 '학문적 경계'를 넘어서 생각하는 법을 이해하기 시작한다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① creative activities — 창의적 활동 (본문에 있으나 think beyond와 결합 시 부자연)
❌ ② common languages — 공통 언어 (think beyond common languages는 문맥 부적합)
✅ ③ disciplinary boundaries — 학문적 경계. think beyond disciplinary boundaries = 학문적 경계를 넘어서 생각하다 ←정답
❌ ④ universal expressions — 보편적 표현 (본문에 근거 없는 조합)
det.tip: disciplinary boundaries = 학문적 경계. think beyond ~ = ~를 넘어서 생각하다
